name: Website trust brief
summary: A trust brief on one domain: when it was registered, its SPF and DMARC mail records, its TLS certificate, and (optional) whether AI crawlers may read it.

rules: every step reads only the domain; all steps run together
registration comes from RDAP; mail protection from the domain's public DNS TXT records; the certificate from a TLS handshake; reachability from one GET of the home page, all as checked today
a missing SPF or DMARC record is an answer (not protected), never a failure
every statement keeps its source link

notes: v1 candidate (100-necklace plan 7-2, workflow 11-15). Leads are verified pearls 52559 (domain.lookup, RDAP) and 132732 (website.ai_readiness, xfix.ai); both passed the relay check at 11:41-11:46. 132732 answered in 12.6 s through the relay, so the crawlers slot gets the whole 5 s budget and may need a longer one after the tuning round.
